from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        """
        Moderated debate to suppress invalid candidate Hamiltonian paths and enforce strict final formatting.
        """
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            agent_prompts=[prompt_custom.HP_AGENT_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.HP_AGENT_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.HP_AGENT_PROMPT_C],
            moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.HP_MODERATOR_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        solution = await debate(problem)
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

Solve the Hamiltonian Path puzzle for this graph.

{problem}

Round {round}. Prior agent proposals:
{all_proposals}

Moderator guidance:
{moderator_input}

Focus on necessary impossibility checks first: isolated vertices, too many leaves, disconnected structure, or a high-degree center attached to many leaves. A Hamiltonian path can include at most two leaves total. Self-loops do not help connect distinct vertices.
Return only your current candidate answer: either a vertex list visiting every vertex exactly once, or NO.
"""

HP_AGENT_PROMPT_B = """
Analyze this Hamiltonian Path instance constructively.

{problem}

Round {round}. Other proposals:
{all_proposals}

Moderator guidance:
{moderator_input}

If proposing a path, verify every consecutive pair is an edge and every vertex appears exactly once. If any proposal violates these rules, prefer NO unless you can construct a valid full path.
Return only the candidate path list or NO.
"""

HP_AGENT_PROMPT_C = """
Determine whether the graph has a Hamiltonian path.

{problem}

Round {round}. Current proposals:
{all_proposals}

Moderator guidance:
{moderator_input}

Be skeptical of false positives on star-like graphs: if one vertex is adjacent to many leaves, a single Hamiltonian path cannot pass through more than two leaves overall. Use this and other degree/connectivity constraints before accepting any path.
Return only a candidate path list or NO, with no explanation.
"""
